name: Eve Motion (EU)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth (Bluetooth is used for Matter setup); Eve's page lists Thread as the wireless connection.

matter.note: CSA lists Eve Motion (vendor 0x130A, product 0x0059) with Matter over Thread; the cited listing is firmware 3.2.1, and earlier listings for 3.1.0 and 3.2.0 share the same product ID.

apple_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). On Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Eve page lists Eve Motion as a Matter device, added locally through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router.

hubRequired.note: No Eve bridge is needed. Eve says the first platform needs a hub with Matter controller and Thread border router functions (e.g. HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K); that is a generic Thread border router, not a brand hub.

localControl.note: The CSA listing describes no Eve cloud, no registration and fully local connectivity; Home Assistant's Eve page says Eve's Matter devices connect locally.

senses.note: Eve describes a motion sensor with an integrated light sensor (twilight setting 0 to 15,000 lux). Whether every Matter platform exposes the light reading is not confirmed.

power.note: Eve's spec lists two replaceable AAA cells; one press article says AA, which the spec contradicts.

summary: Eve Motion is a battery motion sensor with an integrated light sensor and a twilight setting from 0 to 15,000 lux. Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant all add it over Matter on Thread, each via a Thread border router rather than an Eve hub. Control stays local with no Eve cloud. Power is two AAA cells.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router, which must also be a Matter controller.
Whether every platform exposes the light reading is not confirmed.
Older HomeKit/Thread units need Eve's free firmware update to get Matter.

sources.title: New Eve Motion Adds Light Sensor and Thread
